nodes.label: Query plan
nodes.role: A plan is chosen from the question's intent and then executed.
nodes.decision: A plan keyed on query intent instead of one fixed chain of steps.

nodes.label: Hybrid retrieval
nodes.role: Two indexes, BM25 and an in-memory embedding store using cosine similarity, behind an ensemble retriever.

nodes.label: Sentence-level prune
nodes.role: Irrelevant sentences are pruned before the context is built.
nodes.decision: Sentence-level pruning before contextualization, so the generator sees less irrelevant text.

nodes.label: Acceptance rule
nodes.role: Compares the verify score of a draft answer with the acceptance threshold. At or above the threshold the answer is accepted and repair is skipped.
nodes.why: Acceptance is an explicit rule with a number, not an assumption.

io.in: A verify score from 0 to 1 and the threshold (0.72 by default).

nodes.decision: Make acceptance a threshold that a request can override.
nodes.failure: The verify score is only as meaningful as the verifier and the generator; the committed runs use a mock generator.
nodes.control: A score at or above the threshold is accepted; below it, one repair runs.

evidence.text: Committed runs record the final score, whether repair ran and whether the answer was accepted.
evidence.caveat: Mock generator; scores describe harness behavior, not answer quality.

nodes.limitation: No claim is made about answer quality or real model behavior.

nodes.label: Repair step
nodes.role: Makes one more pass with tighter settings: more weight on BM25 (0.5 to 0.7) and less on vectors (0.5 to 0.3), a stricter prune, a constrained template and a lower temperature (0.2 to 0.1), then verifies again.
nodes.why: A bounded second attempt has a fixed cost, and acceptance is decided by the same rule.

io.out: A new draft and a new verify score.

nodes.failure: After the single attempt the answer can still be below the threshold and is then returned as not accepted.
nodes.control: The maximum number of repairs is 1.

evidence.text: In the committed runs that produced scores, every query that used repair ended below 0.72 and was not accepted.
evidence.caveat: Mock generator; scores describe harness behavior.

nodes.limitation: Whether a repair improves an answer is not claimed.
